s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory condition with musculoskeletal involvement and elevated inflammatory markers
salient_findings: bilateral posterior ankle pain and anterior knee pain
pain in the metacarpophalangeal joint of the left third finger
swelling and thickening of the Achilles tendons
tenderness over both tibial tuberosities and the right medial humeral epicondyle
elevated ESR, CRP, rheumatoid factor, anti-CCP2, and MMP-3
key_facts: 59-year-old Japanese woman
6 weeks of bilateral posterior ankle pain and anterior knee pain
4 weeks of pain in the metacarpophalangeal joint of the left third finger
diagnosed with hypertension and heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH) at age 57
initial LDL-C of 359 mg/dL, reduced to ~170 mg/dL on pitavastatin and ezetimibe
no personal or family history of rheumatoid arthritis
bilateral arcus corneae
swelling and thickening of the midportion of both Achilles tendons with tenderness to palpation
tenderness over both tibial tuberosities and the right medial humeral epicondyle
tenderness of the first and fifth right MTP joints and the second left MTP joint
swollen dorsally right third and right second MCP joints
nodule on the extensor tendon of the right third digit
ESR of 118 mm/h
CRP 2.06 mg/dL
rheumatoid factor 49.3 U/mL
anti-CCP2 >300 U/mL
MMP-3 62.3 ng/mL
radiographs showed no erosions or enthesophytes
musculoskeletal ultrasound revealed markedly swollen Achilles tendons with increased vascularity

shortlist.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: highly elevated rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP2 levels, consistent with inflammatory polyarthritis

shortlist.label: Psoriatic Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: presence of enthesitis and dactylitis, which are common features of psoriatic arthritis

shortlist.label: Polymyalgia Rheumatica
shortlist.why_kept: elevated ESR and CRP, and presence of musculoskeletal symptoms such as shoulder and hip pain

shortlist.label: Adult-Onset Still's Disease
shortlist.why_kept: highly elevated inflammatory markers and presence of musculoskeletal symptoms

shortlist.label: Spondyloarthritis with Axial Involvement
shortlist.why_kept: presence of enthesitis and inflammatory back pain, which are common features of spondyloarthritis
